S2: *The refined family (Corollary 1).* With a knot added just below each of the three cut levels (J = 12 instead of 9), κ\* was searched again for all 69 real cuts at the class δ (scripts/v16_real.py). The robust decision changed on 0 of the 69 cuts. κ\* itself differed on 9 cuts; on 6 of them the refined search returned a larger radius although the refined family contains the original one, so that its true radius can only be smaller: in twelve dimensions the vertex, random and local search can miss a reversal that the nine-dimensional search finds. The radii reported in the main text are those of the family (5), for which the random check above applies.
